fusions.name: Clutch and Rake
fusions.desc: Leaps onto an enemy up to 5 tiles away, grips it and rakes it with your hind claws for 13 damage, rising to 1.4 times that from full range. Your grip stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Canopy Potshot
fusions.desc: Throws a stone at the first enemy in line for 4 damage. Against an enemy that has not yet been hurt, its critical chance rises by 40%.

fusions.name: Wrist Catch
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Sinew Under Fur
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 6% faster.
